subproblem.title: boundaryMassOn is subadditive on differences and vanishes on boundaries
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and U, G ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets. Then (a) boundaryMassOn (X − Y) G ≤ boundaryMassOn X G + boundaryMassOn Y G for all X, Y ∈ 𝒟_m(U); and (b) boundaryMassOn (∂X) G = 0 for every X ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U). Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). Integrals ∫_E g dμ are Bochner integrals over μ⌞E; {d < t} abbreviates {x : d(x) < t}.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U m, boundaryMassOn (X - Y) G ≤ boundaryMassOn X G + boundaryMassOn Y G) ∧ ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), boundaryMassOn X.boundary G = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: the boundary-mass bookkeeping of step 12 of the parent-supplied proof of cmcsd_shell_decomposition ((X − Y).boundary = ∂X − ∂Y, ∂∂ = 0, M(0) = 0 and MS). Sibling used: MS = mass_sub (cmc_fc_cs_massOn_sub_le: M_G(A − B) ≤ M_G(A) + M_G(B) for all U, G and A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U)).
1. (M_G(0) = 0 in every degree.) M_G(0) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal 0(ω) = ENNReal.ofReal 0 = 0 over the admissible ω (GeometricCurrentOn.zero_apply), so M_G(0) ≤ 0 (sSup_le), i.e. M_G(0) = 0.
2. (m = 0.) boundaryMassOn of any current of degree 0 is 0 by definition. So (a) reads 0 ≤ 0 + 0, and (b), for the 0-current ∂X, reads 0 = 0.
3. (m = k + 1, part (a).) For Z ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), boundaryMassOn Z G = M_G(∂Z) by definition. For η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), ∂(X − Y)(η) = (X − Y)(dη) = X(dη) − Y(dη) = ∂X(η) − ∂Y(η) = (∂X − ∂Y)(η) (all definitional), so ∂(X − Y) = ∂X − ∂Y (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). By MS (with k, U, G, ∂X, ∂Y), M_G(∂(X − Y)) = M_G(∂X − ∂Y) ≤ M_G(∂X) + M_G(∂Y), which is (a).
4. (m = k + 1, part (b).) For X ∈ 𝒟_{k+2}(U), ∂X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) and boundaryMassOn (∂X) G = M_G(∂∂X) = M_G(0) = 0 by GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_boundary and step 1. ∎

audit.reason: The proof works for arbitrary U and G as stated. It proves zero mass directly, treats degree zero separately, and uses boundary linearity, the declared mass_sub dependency and boundary_boundary in positive degree. Both conjuncts follow without added hypotheses.
